title: Built Heritage Committee - September 15, 2026
meeting_location: Champlain Room, 110 Laurier Avenue West, and by electronic participation

agenda_items.title: Notices and meeting information for meeting participants and the public
agenda_items.description:
Notices and meeting information are attached to the agenda and minutes, including: availability of simultaneous interpretation and accessibility accommodations; in camera meeting procedures; information items not subject to discussion; personal information disclaimer for correspondents and public speakers; notices regarding minutes; and hybrid participation details.
Accessible formats and communication supports are available, upon request.
Except where otherwise indicated, reports requiring Council consideration will be presented to Council on Wednesday , September 23rd, 2026 in Built Heritage Committee Report 34.
The deadline to register by phone to speak, or submit written comments or visual presentations is 4 pm on Monday September 14th, 2026, and the deadline to register by email to speak is 8:30 am on Tuesday, September 15th, 2026.
agenda_items.minutes: These “Summary Minutes” indicate the disposition of items and actions taken at the meeting. This document does not include all of the text that will be included in the full Minutes, such as the record of written and oral submissions. Recorded votes and dissents contained in the Summary Minutes are draft until the full Minutes of the meeting are confirmed by the Committee. The draft of the full Minutes (for confirmation) will be published with the agenda for the next regular Committee meeting and, once confirmed, will replace this document.

sub_agendas_items.title: Consideration of Objection to the Notice of Intention to Designate 575 Island Park Crescent, under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act

attachments.attachment_title: 4.1 - Doc 1 - Objection Letter, 575 Island Park Cresc.pdf
4.1 - Doc 7 - Second Opinion Structural Review, JCAL.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
The Committee received a brief slide presentation overview of the report from Anne Fitzpatrick, Planner III, Planning, Development and Building Services Department. A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
The Committee heard from Jennifer Gillespie, Heritage Chair, Island Park Community Association. A written submission was also received from Linda Hoad, on behalf of Heritage Ottawa (email sent 14 September 2026, held on file with the Office of the City Clerk).
At the conclusion of questions to staff, and with Committee discussions having also concluded, the report recommendation was put before Committee and was ‘Carried’, as presented.

motions.motion_text:
Report recommendation(s)
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council not withdraw the Notice of Intention to Designate 575 Island Park Crescent and proceed with the designation process under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act.

sub_agendas_items.title: Heritage Permit and Easement – Saint-Marc United Church, 325 Elgin Street

attachments.attachment_title: 4.3 - ACS2026-PDB-RHU-0048 - Saint-Marc United Church, 325 Elgin St - Updated.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Prior to the consideration of this item, Vice-Chair Plante read out the following Technical Amendment Motion to allow for the report’s consideration on the current meeting agenda.
The Committee received a slide presentation overview of the report from Taylor Quibell, Planner II, Planning, Development and Building Services Department. A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.
The Committee heard from Hunter McGill, on behalf of Heritage Ottawa. A written submission was also received from Linda Hoad, on behalf of Heritage Ottawa (email sent 14 September 2026, held on file with the Office of the City Clerk).
At the conclusion of questions to the delegation and to staff, and with Committee discussions having also concluded, the report recommendation was put before Committee and was ‘Carried’, as amended by Motion No. BHC 2026-34-01.

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS an incorrect version of Report No ACS2026-PDB-RHU-0048, Heritage Easement – Saint-Marc United Church, 325 Elgin was provided to members of Built Heritage Committee and made available publicly on Thursday, 3 September 2026;
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED THAT the Built Heritage Committee approve the substitution of the report distributed on Thursday, 3 September 2026 with the version that was updated, distributed to members of Committee and posted publicly on Thursday, 10 September 2026.

Report Recommendation(s)
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council direct the City Solicitor to place a by-law for enactment to delegate authority to staff to negotiate, finalize, and register a covenant agreement under the Ontario Heritage Act to ensure the conservation of Saint-Marc United Church at 325 Elgin Street.

sub_agendas_items.title: 1485 and 1495 Heron Road - Heritage Permit Application

attachments.attachment_title: 4.4 - Doc 6 - 1495 Heron Rd - Conservation Design Guidelines.pdf

sub_agendas_items.minutes:
Prior to the consideration of this item, Vice-Chair Plante read out the following Technical Amendment Motion:
At the outset, the Committee received a detailed slide presentation overview of the report from Lesley Collins, Program Manager, Heritage Planning, Planning, Development and Building Services Department. A copy of this presentation is held on file with the Office of the City Clerk.The Committee then heard from the following delegations:
Written submissions were received from the following and are held on file with the Office of the City Clerk:
Following questions to the delegations and to staff, and at the conclusion of Committee discussions, the report recommendations were put before Committee and were ‘Carried’, as amended by Motion No. BHC 2026-34-02.

motions.motion_text:
WHEREAS Report ACS2026-PDB-RHU-0050 is related to a Heritage Permit application for 1485-1495 Heron Road, a property designated under Part IV of the Ontario Heritage Act; and
WHEREAS the property owner has applied for a Minor Zoning By-law Amendment to remove the requirement for a step back above the fourth storey and this requested relief is outlined in the report; and
WHEREAS an incorrect version of the site Concept Plan was included in the report and illustrates a step back above the fourth storey; and
WHEREAS revisions to the report recommendations will provide clarity regarding the scope of the delegated authority and the approvals being recommended to Council; and
WHEREAS the delegation of authority for future applications under Section 33 of the Ontario Heritage Act should be limited in scope to applications that implement the Concept Plan; and
WHEREAS to ensure transparency in decision-making, all future heritage applications subject to the proposed additional delegation of authority should be circulated to heritage stakeholders and the public; and
THEREFORE BE IT RESOLVED that the Concept Plan included as Document 4 to the report be replaced with the Concept Plan dated September 3, 2026, as attached; and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the annotated Concept Plan included on page 7 of the report be replaced with the revised annotated Concept Plan, as attached; and
BE IT FURTHER RESOLVED that the Recommendations of the report be replaced with the following:

Report Recommendation(s)
That the Built Heritage Committee recommend that Council:
